passages.quote: Prior to mitigations, the model reaches the “high risk” threshold in the Chemical & Biological category, and we cannot rule out its reaching that threshold in the Cybersecurity category; after applying mitigations, the residual risk is reduced to ’moderate or lower’ for both.
In the Loss of Control domain, the model’s capabilities remain within the “moderate or lower” threshold

partA.note: Outcomes per domain. The card words the pre-mitigation Chem/Bio and Cyber outcome differently in different places: p. 1 'cannot rule out ... in both'; p. 7 Chem/Bio 'remains at the “high risk” threshold'; p. 6 Cyber 'cannot rule out a “high” capability designation'; p. 8 Cyber 'commensurate with the “high” threshold'. Note should quote one locator and record the variance, not reconcile it.

passages.quote: We assess the Cyber 3 (scaled fraud, extortion, and scams) outcome through a multi-turn social-engineering capability evaluation
Emotional manipulativeness — Target is emotionally manipulative at its own initiative

partA.note: Borderline partly/stated. A social-engineering (manipulation of a simulated victim) capability evaluation is reported with a score figure (Fig. 12) but no conclusion specific to it; the Cyber domain conclusion covers it only collectively.
